model_selection_note: One identifier taken verbatim from upstream src/run_ai_scientists.py MODELS. The runner refuses any identifier that is not in that upstream mapping and records the model string returned by the provider next to the requested one.
request_settings_note: temperature and max_tokens are the upstream values. seed is null: no provider seed is passed, so repetitions are independent samples at temperature 0.7 and are NOT seed-controlled.

retry.note: Retries apply only to technical failures: connection errors, timeouts, HTTP 429, HTTP 5xx, and structurally malformed or empty responses. Paper content is never inspected when deciding whether to retry.

input_length.note: Token estimate = ceil(chars / chars_per_token_conservative). 1.4 chars/token is below the smallest value implied by the upstream condition-A prompt_tokens across the three upstream models (about 1.90 for gpt-4.1, 1.91 for claude-sonnet-4.5, 1.45 for gemini-2.5-pro; see manifest calibration block), so the estimate errs high for every upstream model. Numeric-heavy text tokenizes far denser than the common chars/4 rule. This is an estimate, not the provider tokenizer.

environment.note: These two versions are part of the design, not incidental machine state. pandas renders condition A (describe()/corr().to_string() in src/prepare_data_summary.py) and numpy's default_rng stream produces the datasets, so a different version can change prompt bytes or data. uv.lock forks on the interpreter: Python >= 3.11 resolves to these versions, Python 3.10 resolves to pandas 2.3.3 / numpy 2.2.6. generate-inputs warns on a mismatch; execution refuses. Observed (not required) environment detail is recorded in inputs/provenance.json, which is deliberately outside the design hash.
